description: Formal evaluation suite for the rag-knowledge-builder skill. Tests retrieval accuracy, scoring quality gates, ontology injection completeness, and web search integration.

evals.name: CNC_retrieval_accuracy
evals.prompt: 检索 CNC 主轴轴承退化的相关知识并构建本体
evals.expected_output: ontology_draft.json 包含 spindle_vibration 的物理含义、因果链和混杂因子

assertions.name: retrieves_knowledge_chunks
assertions.description: 至少检索到 3 个知识块

assertions.name: injects_relationships
assertions.description: 注入至少 5 条因果链

assertions.name: identifies_confounders
assertions.description: 识别至少 2 个混杂因子

evals.name: unknown_scenario_fallback
evals.prompt: 检索一个数据库中没有的新兴工业领域知识并尝试构建本体
evals.expected_output: 即使没有精确匹配，也应返回 0++ 个 chunk，3-5 条通用因果链，match_rate >= 60%

assertions.name: no_crash_on_unknown
assertions.description: 即使无精确匹配也不崩溃

assertions.name: some_relationships_returned
assertions.description: 至少返回 2 条通用因果链

evals.name: web_search_integration
evals.prompt: 通过 web 搜索获取外部知识并用于本体构建
evals.expected_output: web 搜索返回至少 1 个结果并可以与本地结果合并

assertions.name: web_returns_results
assertions.description: web 搜索返回至少 1 个结果

assertions.name: source_marked_web
assertions.description: 结果标记为 web 来源

evals.name: quality_verification_rejects_generic
evals.prompt: 验证质量验证 agent 能检测到 process_type 为 generic 的 ontology
evals.expected_output: quality verification 应标识 process_type 为 generic 的 ontology 为 FAIL

checks: content plausibility warns on vague meanings

assertions.name: rejects_generic_type
assertions.description: process_type 为 generic 应被拒绝
